newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups UK shares, downgrades US.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups UK shares, downgrades US.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Monday it had raised its recommendation on the UK equity market to "overweight" from "underweight," but had moved to "underweight" from "overweight" on U.S. equities.
"Our report is out this morning," said European equity strategist Ian Scott. "We have been increasingly positive on the UK market and moved our own weightings prior to Christmas."
